question: Break down Stamping by line for May 2026.
text:
Here's how much energy each Stamping line used in May 2026 (1 May to 31 May). You didn't name a metric, so I used energy consumption.

| Line | Consumption (kWh) |
|---|---|
| Stamping line 1 | 74,641.3 |
| Stamping line 2 | 80,644.2 |
| Stamping line 3 | 124,659.8 |

Line 3 used the most, about 45% of the three lines' combined 279,945.4 kWh. That combined figure is less than Stamping's own total, because the department meter also counts unmetered load and losses.

I can also run this as cost, peak demand or energy per unit.
sql: SELECT r.meter_id AS meter_id, sum(r.kwh) AS value FROM reading r WHERE r.meter_id IN ? AND r.local_date >= ? AND r.local_date < ? GROUP BY r.meter_id ORDER BY r.meter_id
